limitations: Metal-nut tests were inspected in exploratory development.
Screw/transistor frozen-held-out evaluations are category-specific, not production guarantees.
KSDD2 is a separate real-defect supervised task conditionally chosen after MVTec target results.
Image intervals and three-seed variability describe different sources of uncertainty.
Native map interpolation cannot recover defect evidence lost at model input resolution.
Serialized timing cannot verify external system idleness; warm model-only time excludes preprocessing and serving.
